source.title: Some open problems in fixed point theory by means of fixed point structures

trace.notes: Resolved zbMATH document 703916 through the zbMATH Open API metadata: Ioan A. Rus, Libertas Mathematica 14, pages 65-84, 1994. The zbMATH web page itself returned a Cloudflare challenge to local curl, so it was treated as a blocked resolver rather than a readable technical source.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the exact title, zbMATH identifier 703916, OpenAlex work W2615345602, DOI 10.14510/lm.v14i0.732.g604, and candidate landing pages http://www.ara-as.org/index.php/lm/article/download/732/604 and https://system.lm-ns.org/index.php/lm/article/view/732/604. OpenAlex reports open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, has_fulltext=false, and no pdf_url. The DOI landing request returned HTTP 404. Local downloads of the candidate OJS URLs failed due DNS/fetch errors, and no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was recovered. No questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or related works.
Saved failure JSON to outputs/parse-paper/703916.json and outputs/latest.json.
